name: TLS Certificate Time to Expiry (Keystore / Truststore)
description: Raw certificate_expiration_keystore / certificate_expiration_truststore (units as reported by the JMX metric - not independently re-verified here, matches the Splunk Cloud panel's own unlabeled axis).
programText:
data('kafka_schema_registry_certificate_expiration_keystore_certificate_expiration_keystore', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'schemaregistry') and filter('service.instance.id', 'schemaregistry-0')).publish(label='Keystore')
data('kafka_schema_registry_certificate_expiration_truststore_certificate_expiration_truststore', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('service.name', 'schemaregistry') and filter('service.instance.id', 'schemaregistry-0')).publish(label='Truststore')
